scenario: A wireless carrier's accessibility compliance team processes a customer's written disability-accommodation request. The team extracts and normalizes the customer's request and supporting medical/disability documentation, evaluates the request against ADA Title III and FCC 47 CFR 64.604 rules, and produces a formal accommodation-determination memo stating whether the accommodation is approved or denied.
info_flow: habib-pdf-to-json extracts structured fields (disability type, requested accommodation, documentation status) from the customer's PDF submission → presale-regulation-auditor evaluates each extracted field against the applicable ADA/FCC eligibility rules and produces a rule-match assessment → ub2-markdown-report-generator compiles the assessment into a formal accommodation-determination memo delivered to the customer.
